name: m8-smoke
description: Milestone 8 smoke, restarted on the explicit mode profiles (2026-11-10, borg-zoo#54): does the product default (munchkin-class) change when the class rule is pinned off (normal)? The original run compared 4.2.6 against M8 on default, which straddled the mode cutoff - better-borg-c fd683ced (PR 302) makes borg_munchkin_by_class default TRUE on M8 but does not exist on 4.2.6 - so those comparisons are excluded and the smoke now reads the modes on M8 itself.
